query_parsed: Show me how I can irritate my unemployed husband with some clever words.
ai_generated_output_text:
Keep it playful, not cruel. Aim for eye-rolls, not wounds.
Try lines like:
“How’s the CEO of Daytime Operations doing?”
“Busy schedule today, or are you fully booked with vibes?”
“I’d ask what’s on your calendar, but I don’t want to spoil the mystery.”
“You’ve really committed to the work-from-home lifestyle without the work.”
“Should I address you as Director of Sofa Affairs?”
“Another hard day in the field of professional relaxing?”
“Your lunch break seems beautifully consistent.”
“You bring a lot of confidence to a very part-time workload.”
“I support your journey as a stay-at-home legend.”
“Do you want coffee, or is that too much office culture?”
For maximum success:
use a smile
keep it occasional
avoid money/job insecurity if it’s a sore spot
Better still, make it affectionate:
“My favorite freeloader.”
“King of the couch, ruler of my heart.”
“You’re unemployed, but never unfunny.”
If you want, I can make these sharper, sweeter, or specifically tailored to his personality.
